problem: Source "it makes me impatient to hear you" rendered as "It makes me angry to hear you" — intensifies Rochester's exasperation into anger; 'impatient' is plain modern English.
new_text: "You thought! You thought! It makes me impatient to hear you. But you have suffered, and are likely to suffer enough for not taking my advice; so I'll say no more. Carter—hurry! Hurry! The sun will soon rise, and I must get him away."
